name: New York State Energy Research and Development Authority (NYSERDA)
collect_note: Reads NYSERDA's own public solicitations feed (the JSON the Current Solicitations page loads, Program Opportunity Notices section) twice a day and keeps notices that mention agriculture, farms, soil or applied research, so the next Sun and Soil round or any new NYSERDA agrivoltaics notice becomes a call row; the first listed round date is the deadline, so a notice whose first round has passed shows as closed even if a later round is open. The RFP section of the same feed is not read.
evidence: GET /rapi/fundingopportunitiesapi/getfundingopportunities?dataSourceId=a8166835-... HTTP 200 application/json (the endpoint FundingOpportunities.js calls), 5 sections (PON 29, RFI 4, RFP 9, RFQL 5), PON 6206 Sun and Soil round 1 due 12/10/2026, round 2 draft 4/20/2027; robots.txt 200 with no rule for /rapi; no RSS, no sitemap.xml (404); curl with a plain browser UA gets 403 but the SALSAV UA gets 200. Checked 2026-11-12.
